verdicts.reason: A keeps the brick-on-X hero, but the brick and the X are sliced off by a hard vertical edge in the middle of the canvas, so the product looks broken. The headline is too small for the square and keeps the broken 'CONS TRUC TION' spacing. In the bottom row the ORDER NOW button sits between 'Buy 2 only for' and '$14.99', which splits the offer. B is worse: the product is shrunk to a tiny icon jammed in the bottom-left corner. That leaves an empty blue X as the focal point, surrounded by dead space. '$14.99' has been moved up under the headline, away from 'Buy 2 only for', and the CTA floats on its own at the right.
